When Alpha Irisal was still just a giant bloom, it once crossed paths with Lady Irelia—gliding effortlessly upon the wind. Yet the bloom sensed something amiss: Lady Irelia wasn’t truly free. Unsure how to help, it turned to its dear friend Old Clovis for guidance and asked him to craft a seed brimming with extraordinary life force, one that might aid Lady Irelia. Drawing on his innate sensitivity to life itself, Old Clove distilled the essence of all six Iris forms into a single seed—imbuing it with immense vitality. But perhaps something vital was still missing—while the Life Force Seed succeeded in transforming the giant bloom into the Alpha Irisal, it brought no relief to Lady Irelia. In his final moments, Old Clovis lay on his deathbed when Irisal came to bid him farewell, placing the seed gently into his palm, hoping his life might yet begin anew.

Pathfinder, welcome to this issue of the Companion Handbook! This issue’s featured Aniimo is <color=#da8000>Fulmintis</color>!
During your adventures out in the world, complete Companion Handbook quests, raise your Companion Handbook level, and earn superb Companion Handbook rewards!

Companion Handbook Editions
The Companion Handbook’s level progress rewards are divided into the Standard Edition and Advanced Edition. The Advanced Edition requires you to unlock the Advanced Companion Handbook. Rewards include 1 <color=#da8000>Prismana Fulmintis</color> with Perfect Potential, a <color=#da8000>Fulminous Soul (an item used to evolve Fulmintis)</color>, and a range of other rewards. It also grants a special perk: Expanded Aniimo storage capacity. The Advanced Edition raises your Aniimo storage capacity by 5, while the Collector’s Edition raises it by 10. These capacity bonuses do not stack; whichever edition you activate last takes priority.
Unlocking the Collector’s Companion Handbook grants additional rewards and perks immediately on top of the Advanced Companion Handbook.

Quests and Companion Handbook EXP
Quests are divided into weekly quests and edition quests. Each quest can only be completed once, and there is no weekly EXP limit.
Weekly quests refresh every Monday at 04:00 (UTC+8), with progress resetting each week. New Seasonal Quests are added to the quest pool every Monday and stay available for the rest of the season. Newly-added quests remain locked until you finish prerequisite quests in their questline. All quests end when the current Companion Handbook ends.
Companion Handbook EXP can also be obtained from Institute Guide - Daily Activity.
Once the Companion Handbook passes Lv.100, it switches to a repeating reward cycle that caps out at Lv.1000.

Gift Details
You can send a gift to friends who meet the required Affinity and have not yet unlocked the Advanced or Collector’s Companion Handbook. They will receive 1 item that can activate either the Advanced or Collector’s Companion Handbook.

Rerun Details
The Prismana Aniimo Egg from this season’s Companion Handbook will return in Season S3, and will be obtainable through Home-related gameplay.
